newsitem.title: FRANCE: Carrefour says not in talks with Comptoirs.
newsitem.headline: Carrefour says not in talks with Comptoirs.

text.p: Retailer Carrefour said on Monday that it was not in talks to acquire control of Comptoirs Modernes in which it holds a 23 percent stake, a Carrefour spokeswoman said.
"For the moment we're not in negotiations with Comptoirs Modernes," she told Reuters.

Market rumours that Carrefour may seek control have been fuelled by recent talk of consolidation in the French retail sector, revived by Promodes chairman Paul-Louis Halley in a recent interview, and heavy activity in Comptoirs shares.

Comptoirs Modernes shares were 15 francs higher at 2,550 at 1115 GMT, while Carrefour's stock was 1.52 percent lower at 2,850 francs, underperforming the bourse's CAC-40 index, which was down 0.47 percent.
Halley told the newspaper Les Echos earlier this month that he expected the retail industry in France to consolidate to around four big players.
